emblem: A cracked bell ringed by six falling icicles
motto: Every bell rung is a debt repaid.
philosophy: The Echo Cult believes the bells do not awaken the thing beneath Frostpine — they soothe it. Each ring buys the world another winter of peace. If the price is a few stolen Pokémon, a few frightened villages, that is mercy, not malice.

bell_warden.name: Bell Warden
bell_warden.intro: "The Keep is empty. Whatever you came for, you're too late."
bell_warden.defeat: "Gone. He's gone, and he took the bell with him."

krampus_believer.name: Krampus Believer
krampus_believer.intro: "You beat the Director. So what? The bells don't care about you."
krampus_believer.defeat: "The bells were never his. He just knew how to listen."

bell_thief.name: Bell Thief
bell_thief.defeat: "Take it, then. It's just one bell. There are five more."

hunter_sigrun.name: Hunter Sigrun
hunter_sigrun.intro: "You're the one who beat Krampus. Good. Then you'll understand when I take that bell off you."
hunter_sigrun.defeat: "...Strong. And soft. That softness will get someone killed."

echo_priest.name: Echo Priest Maltheus
echo_priest.intro: "Child, we are not stealing the bells. We are returning them."
echo_priest.defeat: "You fight for a seal you have never seen. I pity you."

krampus_defector.name: Krampus Defector
krampus_defector.intro: "I marched under the skull. I know what the bell really does. Walk away."
krampus_defector.defeat: "Fine. The vault. Under the shrine. But you won't like what you hear."

frost_herald.name: The Frost Herald
frost_herald.intro: "FIVE OF SIX. THE THROAT OF WINTER OPENS."
frost_herald.defeat: "THE LAST BELL WILL RING. IT ALWAYS RINGS."

boss_mechanic.name: Chilling Chorus
boss_mechanic.description: Every third turn the five recovered bells resonate: the Herald's team gains Speed and critical-hit chance, while the player's team's accuracy falters.
